story.originalTitle: Alonso extends Aston Martin contract to continue racing in 2027
story.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has extended his contract with Aston Martin and will continue racing in Formula 1 with the team into the 2027 season.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索：阿斯顿·马丁确认西班牙人与兰斯·斯特罗尔续约，2027赛季F1车手阵容保持不变。
费尔南多·阿隆索已与阿斯顿·马丁续约，将继续代表车队征战2027赛季F1。
这位45岁的车手将继续与队友兰斯·斯特罗尔并肩作战，斯特罗尔的续约合同也同时得到车队确认。
曾在2005至2006年两夺世界冠军的阿隆索，将把职业生涯延续到创纪录的第24个赛季。

detailEn: Fernando Alonso: Aston Martin confirm unchanged line-up for 2027 F1 season with Spaniard and Lance Stroll extending contracts
Fernando Alonso will race on in Formula 1 with Aston Martin into the 2027 season having extended his contract.
The 45-year-old will continue to race alongside team-mate Lance Stroll, whose own extended deal has also been confirmed by the team.
Alonso, the two-time world champion from 2005-2006, will prolong his career into a record-extending 24th season.
